bindings: Consumes only frozen WS4 plan and bound WS5 manifest; produces derived checkout and readiness artifacts.
local_mapping: Mapping is LOCAL_EXECUTION_ONLY and never controlled identity, EMS authority, or compliance evidence.
remote_normalization: HTTPS and SSH remotes normalize to host/owner/repository. Origin is canonical when present; multiple non-origin conflicting remotes are ambiguous.
dirty_state: CLEAN or DIRTY; dirty is not auto-cleaned and is disallowed unless supplied controlled policy permits it.
detached_head: Permitted only for matching expected commit; otherwise rejected when a branch is required.
request_gating: Repository authoritative REQUEST_READY entries require VERIFIED checkout. No evaluator is executed.
known_limitations: WS6 verifies synthetic checkout identity/readiness only. It does not execute requests, collect runtime evidence, create review items, produce outcomes, or onboard a real repository.
ws7_prerequisites: WS6 derived checkout verification and readiness artifacts
